conversation_parts.body: Hi Bryn, I’m reaching out because we’ve got a few policyholders asking when they’ll get updates during their claim process. Is there a way to automate those messages?
Thanks for flagging this, Pellin. We’re currently building out the capability for automatic customer milestone messaging — it’s in progress and targeted for early next year.
We’re working on enabling customer milestone messaging so policyholders get timely updates at claim milestones — it’s still in development but we’re aiming to deliver it early next year.
Internal note: Confirm with engineering that milestone notifications are still on track for Q1 2027 before replying to Pellin.
That’s good to hear. I’d like to schedule a follow-up to see how it’s coming along — maybe next week?
Could we schedule a quick call next Tuesday? I’ll be free between 10 and 11 AM if that works for you.
Absolutely — I’ll send over a calendar invite for Tuesday at 10:30 AM if that suits. We can walk through what’s in development and any prep you might need to do on your end.
Perfect — thanks Bryn. Looking forward to it.

Just to confirm — you’re interested in the customer milestone messaging feature, which will let you send automated updates to policyholders at key claim stages. We’ll cover how it integrates with your current workflows.
